identity: A secondary-school geography question bank, 20 four-option items one per layout line: local winds (الخماسين), elements of climate, pressure belts and the doldrums, the California cold current, forms of condensation, three parallel CO2-concentration items for 1960/1980/2000, two parallel deforestation-rate items for Europe and Africa/SE Asia, indicators of climate change, four parallel items on the benefits of planning (بيئية/صحية/اجتماعية/اقتصادية), sustainable development, biogas, sedimentary rocks, and mountain vs geometric borders. Decimal points are stripped, so '0 7' is 0.7 and '0 35' is 0.35.
law: §S. 20 lines × [stem ‖ opt ‖ opt ‖ opt ‖ opt] = 100 boundaries over 391 tokens (3.9 tokens/segment). The whole document turns on the shared-prefix discriminator I confirmed at 100 F1 on doc_c4cb5672fc6c this batch: a head noun printed ONCE ends the stem and the options are the bare modifiers; a head repeated once per option stays inside each option.
reasoning:
Prefix printed ONCE, so it is stem — three families here:
- Item 1 @11: '…وبلاد الشام هي رياح ‖ الدائمة ‖ الموسمية ‖ اليومية ‖ الخماسيين ‖'. This is the exact shape of doc_c4cb5672fc6c's '…العالم الإسلامي الاستعمار ‖ العسكري ‖ الثقافي ‖ …', which graded clean, and of doc_87ac286b6785's 'من زيت ‖ الزيتون ‖'.
- Items 13, 14, 15, 16 @259/@276/@295/@312: four consecutive items ending '…هو من فوائد التخطيط ‖ البيئية ‖ الصحية ‖ الاجتماعية ‖ الاقتصادية ‖'. Four independent repetitions of the same structure is the strongest confirmation available inside a single document — if the stem ended one token earlier the first option would be 'التخطيط البيئية', which is not parallel to the three bare adjectives that follow.
Prefix printed ONCE PER OPTION, so it stays in the options — and I checked each:
- Item 4: الضغط ×4 → stem stops at هو @61.
- Item 5: تيار ×4 → stem stops at الغرب @84.
- Item 18: الوقود ×3 (and once more at the head of the stem) → stem stops at معالجتها @344.
- Items 7, 8, 9: 'جزء من المليون' ×4 → stem stops at 'م' @121/@148/@175, and each four-token concentration is one option.
Numbers: A2. '0 7' / '0 3' / '0 8' / '0 35' in items 10 and 11 are stripped decimals — each pair is ONE option, four options per item, not eight. The dates '1960 م', '1980 م', '2000 م' stay inside their stems as single number-groups.
Item 20's options each contain a و ('يتشابهان دفاعيا ويختلفان مورفولوجيا'), which S2 protects: an option is one segment however many coordinators it holds. Same for item 15's stem, which carries 'وإعادة استخدامها' inside it (S1).
Items 7/8/9 and 10/11 are near-verbatim repeats differing only in a date or a place, and their option sets must split identically — they do, which is the internal check that none of the five was mis-parsed. All 19 pre-<NL> tokens and @390 fall out of the structure without forcing.
